Meta Labeling - This model acts as a secondary filter. It observes a base strategy and predicts whether the base strategy's next trade will be a win or a loss. It operates with signal parameters such as base_model_family=bayesian_markov, meta_threshold=0.6, feature_window_set=[10, 20, 50]. To control risk, it halts trading after 2 consecutive daily losses, restricts to 4 max trades per day, and sets a daily stop loss at 3 units.
